verdicts_or_reports.element: "Folders" section heading in the directory list
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Section headings should be produced consistently for every sorting choice. With Directory Sort Mode = None On Top and Sort By = Name ascending, the interleaved order is aaa.jpg, Alpha, Beta, keep.jpg, notes.txt, report+final.txt, so after the Folders group the remaining files should get a new "Files" heading (Files → Folders → Files).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: List shows a "Files" heading with only aaa.jpg, then a "Folders" heading with Alpha and Beta, and then keep.jpg, notes.txt, report+final.txt are listed under the "Folders" heading with no second "Files" heading.
steps: Open AndroidQA/Amaze
More options > Sort > Directory Sort Mode > None On Top
More options > Sort > Sort By > Name > ASCENDING
Rename photo.jpg to aaa.jpg so the list interleaves a file before the folders (or use any file name that sorts before the folder names)
Observe the section headings in the list: Files (aaa.jpg), then Folders (Alpha, Beta), then more files with no heading
Navigate into Alpha and back: the wrong headings persist

verdicts_or_reports.expected: The chosen directory view mode should survive a screen rotation: after selecting Grid View in portrait, rotating to landscape (and back) should keep the grid layout, just as grid view is kept when navigating into and out of folders.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After selecting Grid View (grid tiles for Alpha/Beta/keep.jpg/aaa.jpg/notes.txt/report+final.txt) and rotating the device, the folder is displayed as a single-column list again (rows with icon, name, date), and the overflow menu offers "Grid View", showing the grid setting was lost. Rotating back to portrait also comes back as a list.
steps: Open AndroidQA/Amaze
More options > Grid View (file list switches to grid tiles)
Rotate the device to landscape
Observe the folder now shows the list layout again; More options > Grid View is offered again
Rotate back to portrait: still list layout

verdicts_or_reports.screen: Amaze folder list (/storage/emulated/0/AndroidQA/Amaze) - portrait after rotation
verdicts_or_reports.element: Directory list layout after rotating from grid view
verdicts_or_reports.expected: The grid view selection should persist across a configuration change (rotation), the same way it persists when navigating into Alpha and back. After rotating from a grid showing big folder tiles, the list should still be a grid.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Grid view is lost on every rotation and the folder reverts to the single-column list (Alpha, Beta, keep.jpg... as rows with icon+name+date). Reproduced three times: portrait grid -> rotate landscape = list; landscape grid -> rotate portrait = list. In landscape the overflow menu shows "Grid View" after the rotation, proving the app is back in list mode. The chosen sort order does survive the rotation, only the view mode does not.
steps: Open AndroidQA/Amaze
More options > Grid View: folders/files are shown as large grid tiles
Verify grid survives navigation: open Alpha and press Back - still grid
Rotate device to landscape: the list is now the single-column list layout (Alpha shown as a row), and More options > Grid View is offered again
Select Grid View again in landscape (tiles appear), rotate back to portrait: reverts to list again

verdicts_or_reports.screen: Left drawer bookmarks / AndroidQA/Amaze file list
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Tapping a bookmark whose target folder no longer exists should not write to storage: it should either follow the renamed folder or show an error/empty state without creating a new directory. A bookmark labelled "Alpha" should likewise reflect/behave consistently with the renamed folder.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After Alpha was renamed to AlphaQA, the drawer bookmark still says "Alpha". Tapping it opens /storage/emulated/0/AndroidQA/Amaze/Alpha showing "0 folders and 0 files"/"No Files", and going Back then shows 3 folders: a newly created empty "Alpha" (7:07 AM) next to the real "AlphaQA" (6:58 AM) — the bookmark navigation silently recreated the missing folder on disk. Reproduced twice (first time the recreated Alpha had 7:05 AM).
steps: Open AndroidQA/Amaze and add bookmark for Alpha (folder context menu > Add to Bookmarks), then open the drawer to confirm the Alpha bookmark exists
Close the drawer and rename Alpha to AlphaQA
Open the drawer again: bookmark entry still reads Alpha
Tap the Alpha bookmark: it opens /storage/emulated/0/AndroidQA/Amaze/Alpha and shows 0 folders and 0 files / No Files
Press Back: Amaze folder now lists 3 folders, including a new empty Alpha (mtime of the moment the bookmark was opened) together with the real AlphaQA folder
